what: Central Texas Food Bank's live locator: all ~21 service-area counties' partner agencies, mobile pantries, and programs (CSFP, HOPE, Golden Harvest, BackPack, CACFP) rendered in one page load. Yielded 263 unique Travis/Williamson/Hays sites, 222 of which were successfully geocoded and merged into pantries.json.
how_to_scrape:
No separate JSON/XHR API exists (checked via browser network inspection) - it is fully server-rendered into the page's <article> element as plain text. Load in a browser (mcp__Claude_Browser__* or claude-in-chrome), get full text via get_page_text/javascript_tool (document.querySelector('article').innerText - page exceeds the 50000-char get_page_text cap, so use javascript_exec .slice() to grab the remainder and reconstruct). Slice by county-name header markers, then regex-parse repeating blocks of the form 'Name

Program: X

Address: Y'. Dedupe same physical site appearing under multiple Program types by stripping ' Partner Agency'/'Mobile Pantry' suffixes and grouping by (name, address). Geocode via one US Census batch addressbatch POST; fall back to individual Nominatim/Census onelineaddress lookups for No_Match rows.
